[34] i. any other information that should reasonably be recognized as sensitive or confidential information of the Recipient or the disclosing party.

[37] The Parties will:

[39] b. keep all Confidential Information strictly confidential by using a reasonable degree of care, but not less than the degree of care used by it in safeguarding its own confidential information; and
[40] c. not disclose any Confidential Information received to any third parties (except as otherwise provided for herein).
[41] The Recipient shall provide the Discloser with original signed copies of all of the Acknowledgements required under the preceding paragraph.
[42] The Parties shall be responsible for any breach of this Agreement by any of their respective Representatives.
[43] 3. Use of Confidential Information.
[44] The Parties agree to use the Confidential Information solely in connection with the Transaction and not for any purpose other than as authorized by this Agreement without the prior written consent of an authorized representative of the Parties.
[45] No other right or license, whether expressed or implied, in the Confidential Information is granted to the Parties hereunder.
[46] Title to the Confidential Information will remain solely with the Party.
[47] All use of Confidential Information by the Parties shall be for the benefit of the Parties and any modifications and improvements thereof by the Recipient shall be the sole property of Discloser.
[48] Notwithstanding the foregoing, Confidential Information shall include any proprietary records created in the course of the Recipient's course of engagement such as customized code, configuration, flowcharts or project data that was specifically designed to meet the needs of the Discloser.
[49] The Parties agree to ensure that all copyright products, such as source codes, system design data/architecture, and other proprietary information, disclosed during the engagement is protected from any misuse, alteration, modification, sharing, or transfer to any party without express permission of the Discloser.
[50] Such data is provided for the sole use of the Parties, and limited for the use under this agreement.
[51] 4. Obligations of Receiving Party.
[52] a. No Use.
[53] The Receiving Party agrees not to use the Confidential Information in any way, or to manufacture or test any product embodying Confidential Information, except for the purpose set forth above.
[54] b. No Disclosure.
[55] The Receiving Party agrees to use the same degree of protection it uses for its own trade secret information, and in no event less than reasonable efforts, to prevent and protect the Confidential Information, or any part thereof, from disclosure to any person other than the Receiving Party's employees having a need for disclosure in connection with the Receiving Party's authorized use of the Confidential Information.
[56] c. Protection of Secrecy.
[57] The Receiving Party agrees to take all steps reasonably within its control to protect the secrecy of the Confidential Information, and to prevent the Confidential Information from falling into the public domain or into the possession of unauthorized persons.
[58] d. No Duplication.
[59] The Receiving Party shall not duplicate Confidential Information furnished in tangible form except for purposes of this Agreement.
[60] e. [61] The Confidential Information retained by the returning Party, the portion of Confidential Information that may be found in Analyses prepared by, or for, the returning Party, and any Confidential Information furnished by the requesting Party not so requested or returned, will be held by the returning Party and kept subject to the terms of this Agreement or destroyed.
[62] 5. Limits on Confidential Information.
[63] The obligations and restrictions imposed by this Agreement will not apply to any information that:
[64] a. The Recipient can demonstrate was already known to the Recipient prior to the disclosure by the Discloser; or,
[65] b. has become publicly known through no wrongful act of the Recipient; or,
[66] c. was received by the Recipient without breach of this Agreement from a third party without restriction as to the use and disclosure of the Discloser's Confidential Information; or,
[67] d. was independently developed by the Recipient without use of the Discloser's Confidential Information; or
[68] e. was ordered to be publicly released by the requirement of a government agency.

[73] c. Notwithstanding the foregoing, if the Discloser is unable to obtain or does not seek a protective order and the Recipient is legally requested or required to disclose such Confidential Information, disclosure of such Confidential Information may be made without liability.
[74] 7. Term.
[75] a. This Agreement shall remain in effect for a two-year term (subject to a one year extension if the parties are still discussing and considering the Transaction at the end of the second year) or the term of the contract, whichever is greater.
[76] b. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the parties' duty to hold in confidence Confidential Information that was disclosed during term shall remain in effect indefinitely.
[77] 8. Remedies.
[78] a. The Parties acknowledge that the Confidential Information is of a unique and valuable character, and that the unauthorized dissemination of the Confidential Information could cause irreparable harm to the Party and the general public.
[79] b. Therefore, the Parties shall be entitled to injunctive relief preventing the dissemination of any Confidential Information in violation of the terms hereof.
[80] Such injunctive relief shall be in addition to any other remedies available hereunder, whether at law or in equity.
[81] c. The Discloser shall be entitled to recover its costs and fees, including reasonable attorneys' fees, incurred in obtaining any such relief.
[82] The Recipient further acknowledges that the unauthorized disclosure of certain information pertaining to "Critical Assets" or "Critical Infrastructure" may constitute a violation of state and federal law.
[83] 9. Return of JEA Confidential Information.
[84] The Recipient shall immediately return and redeliver to the other all tangible material embodying the JEA Confidential Information provided hereunder and all notes, summaries, memoranda, drawings, manuals, records, excerpts or derivative information deriving there from and all other documents or materials ("Notes") (and all copies of any of the foregoing, including "copies" that have been converted to computerized media in the form of image, data or word processing files either manually or by image capture) based on or including any JEA Confidential Information, in whatever form of storage or retrieval, upon the earlier of -
[85] I. the completion or termination of the dealings between the parties contemplated hereunder; or
[86] II. the termination of this Agreement; or
[87] III. at such time as JEA may so request; provided however that the Recipient may retain such of its documents as is necessary to enable it to comply with its statutory document retention policies.
[88] Alternatively, the Recipient, with the written consent of JEA may (or in the case of Notes, at the Recipient's option) immediately destroy any of the foregoing embodying JEA Confidential Information (or the reasonably non-recoverable data erasure of computerized data) and, upon request, certify in writing such destruction by an authorized officer of the Recipient supervising the destruction).
[89] JEA reserves the right to require evidence supporting such an activity.
[90] 10. Notice of Breach.
[91] The Recipient shall notify the Discloser immediately upon discovery that any Confidential Information has been communicated or distributed to any unauthorized person or entity and will cooperate with efforts by the Discloser to help the Discloser regain possession of Confidential Information and prevent its further unauthorized use.
[92] 11. No Warranty.
[93] The Discloser shall have no liability to the Recipient or the Representatives resulting from any use of the Confidential Information.
[94] The Discloser shall have sole responsibility for providing the Confidential Information necessary for Recipient to perform its obligations under the parties' Agreements.
